name: Organic Spectroscopy
description: 1H NMR: Zeeman splitting, effect of magnetic field strength, chemical shift, inductive and anisotropic effect, spin-spin coupling, coupling constant J, examples of AB, AX and ABX system, Simplification of second order spectrum, selective decoupling, use; 13C NMR: Introduction to FT technique, relaxation phenomenon, NOE effects, 1H and 13C chemical shift to structure corrections, Organic functional group identification through IR spectroscopy. Prediction of wavelength using Woodward-Fieser rules.
